verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from both the main portal homepage and the info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt guidance site, which suggests the public reading surface returns server-rendered content rather than a bot wall or JS-only shell. The llms.txt probe also got a plain HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page. However, the captured snippets are mostly navigation and teaser text, and nothing records which user agent fetched them or confirms deep guidance pages load without CAPTCHA or JS gating. Missing for 10: a documented probe with an identified agent UA showing deep guidance/FAQ pages fully rendered, explicit absence of bot-protection or CAPTCHA on reading pages, and independent hands-on corroboration.
